eligibility.evidence: Sections 3 and 4.1-4.3 (pp.6-14): GPT-4 variants are the experimental subjects in three vignette experiments replicating Goel et al. 2017 (gain/loss framing, Tversky & Kahneman 1981), Lee et al. 2018 (perspective-taking) and Nuijten et al. 2016 (deaf effect); new responses analysed by regression. E2 operational test met (cites the human studies); borderline because the tasks are applied IS vignettes rather than classic lab paradigms.

A.title: The Role of Roles: Are LLMs Behavioural in Information Systems Decision-Making?

paradigms.name: Phishing susceptibility: gain/loss framing and contextualisation (Goel et al. 2017, eight emails)
Perspective-taking and launch-date commitment with anticipated guilt (Lee et al. 2018, Study 2)
Messenger role and perceived control in the deaf effect, IT project escalation (Nuijten et al. 2016)
